verdict: Spend is producing clicks but almost no leads — only 2 leads from $2,598 this period.
diagnosis: Cost per lead sits at $1,299 this period, roughly 10x the healthcare wellness benchmark near $98–$141, driven by weak landing page conversion.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $2,598 spend
signals.detail: Lead volume is critically low this period. The campaign is generating traffic but failing to convert visitors into inquiries.

signals.headline: Click-through rate strong at 5.5%
signals.detail: 1,257 clicks on 22,809 impressions shows the 'life alert' keyword and ad copy resonate with the 45–65+ audience.

signals.headline: 138 landing page views, 2 leads
signals.detail: Roughly 1.4% of page viewers convert. The landing experience is the biggest leak in the funnel.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897 tracked
signals.detail: Purchase value exists but attribution mixes with lead flow. Worth confirming whether these are true sales or pixel duplicates.

signals.headline: 165 unread conversations piling up
signals.detail: Inbound messages are stacking without response. Missed replies likely explain some of the lead shortfall.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Business-to-consumer wellness leads average around $98, with healthcare subcategories like hearing aids and elder care trending higher this year. Liferun's $1,299 cost per lead this period is far above range.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Summer is soft for senior safety buys
seasonal.body: Medical alert purchases spike after a fall or health event, not by season. Roughly 75% of buyers act reactively, so demand stays steady year-round rather than following a summer pattern.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Bay Alarm and Medical Guardian lead 2026
competitor.body: Bay Alarm Medical and Medical Guardian dominate 2026 rankings on price and response time. Apple Watch is pulling share from traditional pendants by skipping the monthly fee entirely.

recommendations.title: Rework the landing page for one clear phone call action
recommendations.detail: Only 1.4% of page viewers convert. Consider testing a simpler page with a large phone number, trust badges, and a single form above the fold.

recommendations.title: Answer the 165 unread inbound conversations this week
recommendations.detail: Missed messages are lost leads. Worth assigning someone to clear the backlog and setting an auto-reply for after-hours inquiries from Google Ads calls.

recommendations.title: Test adult-child targeting alongside the 45–65+ audience
recommendations.detail: Adult children research and buy for parents but purchase intent dropped to 22% in 2026. Test ad copy aimed at sons and daughters, not just seniors.
